schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
AcceptanceCriterionRecord (new) — step acceptance criteria tagged with the revision that applied them and whether they are in force or superseded
ProvenAcceptableRange (new model) — per attribute x parameter PAR, the two analyses of PCMP-001 §6.4 as the report prints them
RhetoricalSpan (new model) — argument-structure roles over the report prose
out_of_schema_notes: No set-point or NOR of the step changed at Version 2.0, so ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the values of the parameter table, which are also the values in force. For the four multivariate parameters ProcessParameter.PAR is the NOR-propagated PAR, which is the range studied for both aggregate and host cell protein. Elution flow rate (GPP, univariate) has no PAR: the report states only that its range studied is supported by its own data for aggregate and host cell protein. rationale_for_criticality carries the classification argument of the report, each parameter anchored on its own sentences of it.

The step sets no quality attribute. The QualityAttribute records are the five attributes the step clears (the attributes-in-scope table). acceptance_criteria holds the drug substance criterion of the register and, for aggregate, host cell protein and fragments, the Version 2.0 intermediate acceptance criterion of the pool in force with its a priori value; residual DNA and leached Protein A carry no criterion at this step. acceptance_criteria (the annex layer) holds the rows of the criteria-change table, Version 1.0 superseded and Version 2.0 in force. Step yield is a process performance attribute with no criterion: the concept attr:step_yield.

proven_acceptable_ranges: the eight rows of the PAR table (aggregate and host cell protein against the four multivariate parameters), with par_at_setpoint and par_nor_propagated as the columns 'PAR at set-point' and 'PAR, NOR-propagated' print them; characterization_range is the range studied of the parameter table. The report's description of the two analyses is in report statements in its own words. Fragments have no adequate model and no PAR: an explicit non-claim.

The schema has no record type for a discrepancy from the plan. PD-007-01 to PD-007-12 are report statements anchored on their rows of the discrepancy register; the studies they concern carry that row as a source reference.

The report records no deviation: a characterization study is not GMP manufacture, so the two events of execution are study events, under the numbers Version 1.0 gave them (DEV-007-01, DEV-007-02). They are Deviation records, the schema's only record type for an event of execution; no_impact_on_conclusions is true for both, which the report judged from the data (the deletion of the run) and retained.

Studies: S-CEX-SDM, S-CEX-SCR, S-CEX-RSM and S-CEX-UNI have StudyDesign records, each anchored on its row of the execution-window table. Only the two designs carry n_runs, which the corpus test reserves for the seeded DoE designs. The fractionated run and method comparability S-CEX-FRC (PD-007-09) has no study type in the schema, and the cation exchange runs S-CEX-VER and S-VI-WC belong to PCR-006 (PD-006-02, PD-006-03); the three are report statements on their rows of the execution-window table.

StatisticalModelFit: the planned full quadratic of each output with a criterion (the re-evaluation table), the selected models of aggregate (log scale, all four adequacy criteria met), host cell protein (log scale, fails the criterion on residuals and influential runs, used for the ranges and the design space, PD-007-02), fragments (not adequate, no coefficient table, so its terms carry no values) and step yield, the three screening models, and the two models of the residual DNA clearance factor and of pool leached Protein A. A p-value printed as '< 0.001' has no float value; its term carries significant=true. The deletion of each flagged run and the models within two AICc units are report statements, one per row of their tables.

parameter_impacts_attribute / parameter_does_not_significantly_impact_attribute: for aggregate and host cell protein, each multivariate parameter on every coefficient row of the selected model that contains it (a parameter affects the attribute when one of its terms is significant at the α of PCMP-001 §6.2), or on its screening effect row where the selected model has no term in it; for step yield on the rows of its selected model or of the screening model; elution flow rate on the rows of the comparison of the two ends; residual DNA clearance on the sentences that state its selected model has no term.
The equipment ids equip:cex_sdm_column and equip:<chamber> follow the Version 1.0 report and the PCP-007 Version 2.0 annex.
rhetorical_spans: authoring/rhetorical/PCR-007.spans.yaml, re-curated against the Version 2.0 text in the same pass as this builder. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: Step 7 of the A-Mab drug substance process and its principal aggregate polishing step, operated in bind and elute mode on a resin with a sulfonate ligand. The antibody is bound to the resin and eluted by a step change in pH; the pool is collected between a threshold on the ascending edge of the elution peak and the stop collect threshold on its descending edge, both read as absorbance at 280 nm. Aggregate binds more strongly than monomer and elutes later, so the step separates the two by where the pool is cut. The step clears host cell protein, residual DNA, leached Protein A and part of the fragments, sets no quality attribute of its own and claims no viral clearance.
input_materials: neutralized pool of the low-pH viral inactivation step
equipment: scale-down model of the commercial column

source_references.quote: Cation exchange chromatography is Step 7 of the A-Mab drug substance process and its principal aggregate polishing step.
The antibody is bound to the resin and eluted by a step change in pH, and the step clears host cell protein, residual DNA, leached Protein A and part of the fragments.
Cation exchange is Step 7 of this train.
It receives the neutralized pool of the low-pH viral inactivation step and passes its eluate pool to anion exchange.
The step is operated in bind and elute mode on a resin with a sulfonate ligand.
Aggregate binds more strongly than monomer and elutes later, so the step separates the two by where the pool is cut.

Load is expressed in grams of antibody per litre of resin and every buffer volume in column volumes, so each parameter of the study has its commercial value.
The record names an instrumented system for the response-surface study only, the temperature-controlled chromatography chamber EQ-CHR-118.
It was in calibration for the whole study, which closed on 2026-03-27, before its next calibration fell due on 2026-05-30.

parameters.rationale_for_criticality: Classified WC-CPP under SOP-4001 by the decision logic of PCMP-001 §7.7. It affects aggregate, through its main effect and its interactions with elution buffer pH and elution stop collect, and host cell protein, through its main effect. With the other factors at their set-points, aggregate rises from 0.56 % to 1.03 % and host cell protein from 99.7 to 211 ng/mg across the range of 10–40 g/L resin. Its proven acceptable range for both attributes is the range studied, 8 g/L resin beyond each end of its NOR, and the load is set by the mass of antibody applied per litre of resin.

parameters.rationale_for_criticality: Classified GPP under SOP-4001 by the decision logic of PCMP-001 §7.7. The class rests on a judgement of practical relevance, for which no plan sets a threshold. No difference was detected in aggregate or host cell protein, and every result at both ends of the range studied, 100–300 cm/hr, met its criterion. Residual DNA clearance was 0.32 log10 lower at the high end (p = 0.044), so residual DNA is affected under PCMP-001 §6.2; the difference is a factor of 2.1 in the residual DNA of the pool, and if the whole factor reached the drug substance its capability index would be 2.67, above the target, so the report judges the effect too small to move residual DNA appreciably in the drug substance. For step yield the study cannot exclude an effect as large as that of protein load, and for fragments, which were not measured, the class rests on the mechanism alone.

non_claims.subject: curvature of host cell protein in load
non_claims.statement: The curvature in load of the host cell protein model is kept for prediction and is not claimed as a finding, because it is smaller than the spread of the centre points.

source_references.quote: PCP-007 §12 states that an effect smaller than the spread of the centre points will not be claimed, so the curvature is kept in the model for prediction and is not claimed as a finding.

non_claims.subject: cause of the run-order drift
non_claims.statement: The record gives no cause for the run-order drift of the host cell protein residuals.

source_references.quote: The record gives no cause for the drift.

non_claims.subject: range and effects for fragments
non_claims.statement: No range and no predicted level is derived for fragments, and no effect on fragments is claimed from their model, which does not meet PCMP-001 §7.2.

source_references.quote: Fragments are therefore judged on their measured results, and no range and no predicted level is derived for them.

The stop collect term of the fragment model has the direction expected in Section 2.1 , fragments rising as the stop collect setting rises and collection stops earlier, but no effect on fragments is claimed from a model that does not meet PCMP-001 §7.2.

non_claims.subject: dependence of leached Protein A on load
non_claims.statement: The data do not show a dependence of leached Protein A on load, and none is claimed.

non_claims.subject: cause of the stop collect results
non_claims.statement: The mechanism does not explain the rise of aggregate with the stop collect setting or the absence of a stop collect term in the yield model, and the report gives no cause.

source_references.quote: The mechanism of Section 2.1 does not explain these results, and this report gives no cause for them.

non_claims.subject: cause of the pH × conductivity interaction
non_claims.statement: The pH × conductivity interaction on host cell protein was not expected, and the mechanism does not explain it.

source_references.quote: The pH × conductivity interaction was not expected, and the mechanism of Section 2.1 does not explain it.

non_claims.subject: confirmation of the design space at manufacturing scale
non_claims.statement: The design space has not been confirmed at manufacturing scale near the edges of the ranges studied, and it holds only at the set-point of elution flow rate and within the qualified life of the resin.

source_references.quote: The design space has not been confirmed at manufacturing scale anywhere near the edges of the ranges studied.
The claim also holds only at the set-point of elution flow rate, which is not a factor of the designs, and only within the qualified life of the resin.

non_claims.subject: proven acceptable range of fragments
non_claims.statement: Fragments have no adequate model, and no proven acceptable range is derived for them.

source_references.quote: Fragments have no adequate model, and no proven acceptable range is derived for them.

non_claims.subject: ranges beyond the range studied
non_claims.statement: Every proven acceptable range is the range studied, and no claim is made beyond it.

source_references.quote: Every range is the range studied, so each proven acceptable range reaches the edge of the characterized range and no claim is made beyond it (PCMP-001 §7.6).

deviations.summary: Expired acetate load/wash buffer lot used in screening run 6
deviations.impact_statement: The retained sample of lot LOT-BUF-2287, expired on 2026-02-11, was re-tested under SOP-2103; the record gives no acceptance range for the values, so the report does not judge the lot from them. The screening design identifies effects and sets no range, so the run was retained.

deviations.summary: Column inlet temperature excursion during RSM run 14
deviations.impact_statement: Temperature is not a factor of the designs. The verification of aggregate by 3 SEC determinations under AMV-3221 decides nothing, because the record gives neither their result nor a criterion. With run 14 excluded and the selection repeated, aggregate and host cell protein still meet their criteria over the NOR (highest single-run limits 1.39 % and 288 ng/mg), the whole region studied still meets them and the verification outcome is unchanged; the aggregate model loses its conductivity term and the step yield model replaces its load × conductivity interaction with a stop collect term. The run was retained.

design_spaces.definition: The region of the four multivariate parameters, within their ranges studied, over which every output with a criterion meets it at both ends of the 95 % prediction interval of a single run (PCMP-001 §6.2, PCP-007 §7.5): aggregate and host cell protein through their selected models at manufacturing scale, fragments through their measured results in the scale-down model, all of which met the criterion. On a grid of 14,641 points 100 % of the region meets every criterion in force, and the region drawn on the mean prediction is also the whole region. At the a priori host cell protein criterion 99.85 % of the grid would meet every criterion. Host cell protein comes nearest to its criterion, with a highest single-run limit of 408 ng/mg at the corner of highest load and lowest conductivity, outside the NOR. The NOR lies inside the design space. The claim is bounded near that corner by one screening result above the criterion, by the other host cell protein models within two AICc units, and by the run-order drift of host cell protein; it is not confirmed at manufacturing scale near the edges of the ranges studied and holds only at the set-point of elution flow rate and within the qualified life of the resin.

source_references.quote: The design space of the step is the region of its four multivariate parameters, within their ranges studied, over which every output with a criterion meets it at both ends of the 95 % prediction interval of a single run (PCMP-001 §6.2, PCP-007 §7.5).
Aggregate and host cell protein enter through their selected models, at manufacturing scale.
They constrain the region through their measured results in the scale-down model, all of which met the criterion.
On the grid of 14,641 points, 100 % of the region meets every criterion in force.
No attribute bounds the region within the ranges studied.
The NOR lies inside the ranges studied for every parameter, and inside the design space.
That result rests on the widening of the host cell protein criterion ( Section 7.1 ).
Four results bound this claim near the corner of highest load and lowest conductivity.

source_references.quote: It sets no quality attribute of its own.

statements.statement_text: During the re-analysis, two studies of the low-pH viral inactivation report ran this step on the same scale-down model, at its set-point and on material from the low-pH step, to test how well it clears aggregate and fragments.

source_references.quote: During the re-analysis, two studies of the low-pH viral inactivation report ran this step on the same scale-down model, at its set-point and on material from the low-pH step, to test how well it clears aggregate and fragments.

statements.statement_text: Protein load, load/wash conductivity, elution buffer pH and elution stop collect were studied in a two-level full factorial screening design of 19 runs and in a face-centred central composite design of 28 runs.

source_references.quote: Protein load, load/wash conductivity, elution buffer pH and elution stop collect were studied in a two-level full factorial screening design of 19 runs and in a face-centred central composite design of 28 runs.

statements.statement_text: Elution flow rate was assessed one factor at a time.

source_references.quote: Elution flow rate was assessed one factor at a time.

statements.statement_text: The scale-down model is qualified for aggregate and host cell protein by its offsets from manufacturing scale, and every judgement of those two outputs is stated at manufacturing scale.

source_references.quote: The scale-down model is qualified for aggregate and host cell protein by its offsets from manufacturing scale, and every judgement of those two outputs is stated at manufacturing scale.

statements.statement_text: The a priori criterion is the value derived before the studies, from the drug substance criterion and the platform worst cases of the later steps.

source_references.quote: The a priori criterion is the value derived before the studies, from the drug substance criterion and the platform worst cases of the later steps.

statements.statement_text: The criterion in force is that value after this campaign’s data on the later steps tightened or widened it.

source_references.quote: The criterion in force is that value after this campaign’s data on the later steps tightened or widened it.

statements.statement_text: For host cell protein the qualification holds at the criterion in force of 418 ng/mg and would not hold at the a priori criterion of 400 ng/mg.

source_references.quote: For host cell protein the qualification holds at the criterion in force of 418 ng/mg and would not hold at the a priori criterion of 400 ng/mg.

statements.statement_text: Aggregate and host cell protein met their intermediate acceptance criteria at every combination of NOR low, set-point and NOR high.

source_references.quote: Aggregate and host cell protein met their intermediate acceptance criteria at every combination of NOR low, set-point and NOR high.

statements.statement_text: Its highest value over the NOR was 1.40 % for aggregate against 4.90 %, and 289 ng/mg for host cell protein against 418 ng/mg.

source_references.quote: Its highest value over the NOR was 1.40 % for aggregate against 4.90 %, and 289 ng/mg for host cell protein against 418 ng/mg.

statements.statement_text: The aggregate criterion is the drug substance criterion of 5.00 % less the largest rise expected across UF/DF, 0.104 percentage points.

source_references.quote: The aggregate criterion is the drug substance criterion of 5.00 % less the largest rise expected across UF/DF, 0.104 percentage points.

statements.statement_text: Fragments have no adequate model and were judged on their measured results, which lay between 0.47 % and 0.76 % against 2.00 %.

source_references.quote: Fragments have no adequate model and were judged on their measured results, which lay between 0.47 % and 0.76 % against 2.00 %.

statements.statement_text: On the single-run limit and at the criteria in force, the design space covers the whole characterized region.

source_references.quote: On the single-run limit and at the criteria in force, the design space covers the whole characterized region.

statements.statement_text: At the a priori host cell protein criterion it would cover 99.85 % of it.

source_references.quote: At the a priori host cell protein criterion it would cover 99.85 % of it.

statements.statement_text: The proven acceptable range of every parameter for aggregate and host cell protein is its range studied.

source_references.quote: The proven acceptable range of every parameter for aggregate and host cell protein is its range studied.

statements.statement_text: The models of aggregate and host cell protein were selected on the log scale and meet the first three adequacy criteria of PCMP-001 §7.2.

source_references.quote: The models of aggregate and host cell protein were selected on the log scale and meet the first three adequacy criteria of PCMP-001 §7.2.

statements.statement_text: The host cell protein model does not meet the fourth, because its residuals drift with the order of execution.

source_references.quote: The host cell protein model does not meet the fourth, because its residuals drift with the order of execution.

statements.statement_text: The highest single-run limit over the NOR stays below the criterion with the whole drift added to it.

source_references.quote: The highest single-run limit over the NOR stays below the criterion with the whole drift added to it.

statements.statement_text: Elution flow rate was classified as a general process parameter, by a judgement of the practical relevance of its effect on residual DNA (Section 9).

source_references.quote: Elution flow rate was classified as a general process parameter, by a judgement of the practical relevance of its effect on residual DNA ( Section 9 ).

statements.statement_text: Within its NOR the step cleared aggregate less than the platform worst case on which the criteria upstream rely.

source_references.quote: Within its NOR the step cleared aggregate less than the platform worst case on which the criteria upstream rely.

statements.statement_text: The platform worst case for host cell protein was confirmed with the offset at its estimate.

source_references.quote: The platform worst case for host cell protein was confirmed with the offset at its estimate.

statements.statement_text: The platform worst case for fragments was confirmed by the rule of PCP-007 §7.6, which confirms a platform worst case when the lowest clearance factor predicted within the NOR is not below it.

source_references.quote: The platform worst case for fragments was confirmed by the rule of PCP-007 §7.6, which confirms a platform worst case when the lowest clearance factor predicted within the NOR is not below it.

statements.statement_text: The fragment model behind that prediction does not meet PCMP-001 §7.2.

source_references.quote: The fragment model behind that prediction does not meet PCMP-001 §7.2.

source_references.quote: Version 1.0 recorded 2 events of execution, which this report keeps as study events under their Version 1.0 DEV numbers.

source_references.quote: Five concern records the plan required that are not in the study record.

statements.statement_text: The other two are the fractionated runs of S-CEX-FRC, which no version of the plan foresaw, and the approaches this report takes where the plan sets no threshold, with capability given for the drug substance and not for the step.

statements.statement_text: PCP-007 §2 sets six objectives.

source_references.quote: PCP-007 §2 sets six objectives.

source_references.quote: “To quantify the relationship between each studied parameter and each response of the step, over ranges wider than the ranges in which the step will be operated.”

statements.statement_text: Objective 2 of PCP-007 §2: “To define the multivariate region over which the fitted models predict that the aggregate, the host cell protein and the fragment content of the eluate pool all meet the criteria in Table 7.1” of the plan.

source_references.quote: “To define the multivariate region over which the fitted models predict that the aggregate, the host cell protein and the fragment content of the eluate pool all meet the criteria in Table 7.1” of the plan.

statements.statement_text: Objective 3 of PCP-007 §2: “To establish a proven acceptable range for each parameter against the aggregate, the host cell protein and the fragment content of the pool, both with the rest of the step at target and with the rest of the step varying within its normal operating ranges.”

source_references.quote: “To establish a proven acceptable range for each parameter against the aggregate, the host cell protein and the fragment content of the pool, both with the rest of the step at target and with the rest of the step varying within its normal operating ranges.”

statements.statement_text: Objective 4 of PCP-007 §2: “To classify each parameter under SOP-4001, from the size of its demonstrated effect and from the capability with which the parameter is controlled.”

source_references.quote: “To classify each parameter under SOP-4001, from the size of its demonstrated effect and from the capability with which the parameter is controlled.”

statements.statement_text: Objective 5 of PCP-007 §2: “To state the ranges, in-process controls and monitoring this step contributes to the control strategy, and to justify them for Stage 2.”

source_references.quote: “To state the ranges, in-process controls and monitoring this step contributes to the control strategy, and to justify them for Stage 2.”

statements.statement_text: Objective 6 of PCP-007 §2: “To verify the platform worst cases of cation exchange on which the criteria upstream rely.”

source_references.quote: “To verify the platform worst cases of cation exchange on which the criteria upstream rely.”

statements.statement_text: Objectives 2 and 3 were amended at Version 2.0 of the plan to include fragments, and objective 6 was added.

statements.statement_text: Its drug substance is purified by Protein A chromatography, low-pH viral inactivation, cation exchange chromatography, anion exchange chromatography, small-virus retentive filtration and ultrafiltration/diafiltration.

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 1: Objective 1 is met. The relationships between the four multivariate parameters and the outputs of the step were quantified over ranges wider than the NORs. Protein load, elution buffer pH and elution stop collect affect aggregate, and protein load and load/wash conductivity affect host cell protein, with pH acting through conductivity. The stop collect acts on aggregate in the direction opposite to the expectation.

source_references.quote: Objective 1 is met. The relationships between the four multivariate parameters and the outputs of the step were quantified over ranges wider than the NORs. Protein load, elution buffer pH and elution stop collect affect aggregate, and protein load and load/wash conductivity affect host cell protein, with pH acting through conductivity. The stop collect acts on aggregate in the direction opposite to the expectation.

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 2: Objective 2 is met for aggregate and host cell protein and not met for fragments. The design space is drawn on the single-run limit, at manufacturing scale, for aggregate and host cell protein. At the criteria in force it covers the whole region studied, and at the a priori host cell protein criterion it would cover 99.85 %. Host cell protein comes nearest to its criterion, at a corner outside the NOR. Fragments have no adequate model, so no model predicts where they meet their criterion. Their measured results, all below the criterion, constrain the region instead.

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 3: Objective 3 is met for aggregate and host cell protein and not met for fragments. Every output meets its intermediate acceptance criterion across the NOR. The highest single-run limits are 1.40 % for aggregate and 289 ng/mg for host cell protein, and fragments were 0.76 % at most. Every proven acceptable range of aggregate and host cell protein is the range studied. Fragments have no adequate model and therefore no proven acceptable range.

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 5: Objective 5 is met. The step contributes its parameter ranges, the criteria it sets for the steps upstream and the criteria it hands on to the control strategy. No in-process control or monitoring of the pool is proposed beyond these. The capability indices of the drug substance attributes it clears exceed 1.33, the lowest 6.14 for host cell protein.

statements.statement_text: Conclusion 6: Objective 6 is met. The platform worst case for aggregate was not confirmed, and its bound of 1.40 tightened the aggregate criteria upstream. The worst case for host cell protein was confirmed with the offset at its estimate and would not be at the unfavourable end of its interval. The worst case for fragments was confirmed by the rule of PCP-007 §7.6, because the lowest clearance factor predicted within the NOR is not below it, but on a model that does not meet PCMP-001 §7.2. The worst case for leached Protein A stands without verification by a model.

source_reference.quote: Aggregate and host cell protein met their intermediate acceptance criteria at every combination of NOR low, set-point and NOR high.
The proven acceptable range of every parameter for aggregate and host cell protein is its range studied.
The host cell protein model does not meet the fourth, because its residuals drift with the order of execution.
The highest single-run limit over the NOR stays below the criterion with the whole drift added to it.
The highest limit over the whole region studied would not, and nor would the limit over the NOR with the offset at the unfavourable end of its interval, on which the qualification rests
The platform worst case for host cell protein was confirmed with the offset at its estimate.
The platform worst case for fragments was confirmed by the rule of PCP-007 §7.6
The fragment model behind that prediction does not meet PCMP-001 §7.2.
Both runs were retained in the analysis.
Below its isoelectric point the antibody carries a net positive charge and binds the ligand.
Aggregate binds more strongly than monomer and elutes later, so the step separates the two by where the pool is cut.
Enveloped virus is claimed at low-pH inactivation, anion exchange and virus filtration, and small viruses at anion exchange and virus filtration
Aggregate presents more positive charge to the ligand than monomer does, so it is retained more strongly and elutes on the tail of the elution peak.
DNA carries a strong negative charge and is repelled by the ligand, so its clearance is large and is not expected to depend on the parameters studied.
Free leached Protein A does not bind under load conditions, but the leached Protein A in complex with the antibody binds with it, which limits the clearance to a modest factor.
The ionic strength of the load and the wash does not change the relative charge of aggregate and monomer at the elution pH, and that difference in charge is what separates them.
Aggregate has the highest criticality of the five and is the attribute the step exists to control.
Host cell protein is cleared here and at anion exchange, so the pool of this step must be one that anion exchange can bring to the drug substance criterion.
